question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

events.title: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
events.description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's extensive consolidation of power, including abolition of presidential term limits in 2018 and appointment of loyalists to key posts, underpins the market's strong consensus against removal before the end of 2026. Recent developments, such as his oversight of the 2026 National People's Congress sessions and planning for the 2026-2030 period, along with continued purges of military figures that reinforce rather than undermine central authority, show no signs of elite challenges or succession moves ahead of the 21st Party Congress. China's tightly controlled information environment and surveillance apparatus further limit organized opposition. While trader pricing reflects these structural realities, low-probability shifts could still arise from a sudden health crisis, major economic disruption triggering internal dissent, or unexpected diplomatic setbacks that erode his position within the Politburo.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the named individual wins and accepts the 2028 nomination of the Democratic Party for U.S. president. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Democratic Party sources.

Any replacement of the democratic nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

events.title: Democratic Presidential Nominee 2028

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the named individual wins and accepts the 2028 nomination of the Democratic Party for U.S. president. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Democratic Party sources.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Democratic field for the 2028 nomination remains fragmented two years before primaries, with traders assigning Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Gavin Newsom, and Jon Ossoff the top probabilities in a tight cluster that reflects competing progressive, moderate, and Southern coalition appeals without a clear frontrunner. Recent market shifts have narrowed Newsom’s earlier lead while elevating Ocasio-Cortez and Ossoff, driven by their national visibility and positioning ahead of the 2026 midterms that will test Senate and gubernatorial records. National polling aggregates sometimes favor Kamala Harris, yet early-state surveys highlight regional and ideological splits, and the DNC’s proposed South Carolina-first calendar has sharpened focus on coalition-building. Separation will likely hinge on midterm outcomes, formal announcements, endorsements, and primary performance in diverse early states.
